script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. STUDIO APARTMENT - NIGHT

JAMES, a brilliant scientist with a disheveled appearance, frantically works on a project in his dimly lit apartment. He's surrounded by various gadgets, blueprints, and equations. His phone rings, and he answers, breathless.

JAMES
(into phone)
I'm almost there! The formula is almost perfect.

Suddenly, the power goes out, plunging the room into darkness. James looks around, confused, as the emergency lights flicker on.

JAMES
(into phone)
What was that? I'll call you back.

INT. STREETS - NIGHT

James exits his building, phone in hand. He looks up at the sky, which is filled with an eerie, orange glow. People are screaming and running in the streets. He turns to see a massive, metallic figure in the distance, its limbs twisting and contorting.

INT. CAFE - DAY

The next day, James meets with his best friend, LUCY, a brilliant botanist, in a cozy café. They discuss the strange power outage and the appearance of the metallic figure.

LUCY
(concerned)
Do you think it's connected to your work?

JAMES
(shrugs)
I don't know, but I can't ignore the coincidence.

INT. STUDIO APARTMENT - NIGHT

James returns to his apartment, determined to continue his research. He sets up a makeshift laboratory in the living room.

JAMES
(to himself)
I won't let this stop me.

INT. LABORATORY - DAY

James works tirelessly in the laboratory, fueled by his obsession. Lucy visits, bringing him food and offering support.

LUCY
You need to rest, James. This isn't worth your health.

JAMES
(frustrated)
I can't let this mystery go unsolved!

INT. STREETS - NIGHT

One night, the metallic figure appears again, causing chaos and destruction in its wake. James and Lucy follow it, determined to understand its origins.

INT. METALLIC FIGURE - INTERIOR - NIGHT

James and Lucy finally manage to enter the figure, discovering a being of pure energy at its core. It communicates telepathically, revealing that it's a sentient being from a dying planet.

BEING
We came seeking a new home. Your world is the only one we've found that can sustain us.

INT. CAFE - DAY

James and Lucy return to the café, where they share the news with the rest of the world. The being is welcomed, and humanity works together to build a new home for it.

INT. STUDIO APARTMENT - NIGHT

James and Lucy sit in James' apartment, exhausted but content.

LUCY
We did it, James. We found a new friend.

JAMES
(smiling)
Yes, Lucy, we did.

FADE OUT.

THE END
